nm_match: Require successful inspection of the full archive, then exact complete output lines for all six Mach-O-prefixed symbols. --defined-only excludes undefined symbols; no member filtering or fallback is permitted.
framework_assertion: Read XCFramework Info.plist, require one non-simulator ios/arm64 slice, and compare static archive and generated header bytes to Cargo outputs before inspection. Inspect Cargo symbols once; copies inherit symbol validation only through rechecked exact archive byte identity, recorded explicitly. Keep independent header syntax/layout checks in all three include-directory contexts.

header_generator.configuration: cbindgen 0.29.0 C language; excludes only portable sockaddr aliases, not these exports.

header_verification: Compile assert_header.c with the same iOS SDK using clang -fsyntax-only; check function-pointer types and 64-bit repr(C) error/peer layouts. Never link or execute the target.
insert_after: Compile iOS transport and stage local framework, before package resolution/app compilation.
root_requirements: Copy the three gate source files and required-symbols.json into the authorized compile-only harness before enabling the gate.
Update exact owner/source-parity/compatibility pins to the reviewed committed sources; do not build old 803f936 with the new Swift caller.
Keep the pinned Rust/Xcode toolchains, source acquisition, artifact hashing and existing admission gates unchanged.
limitations: No compiler, cbindgen, nm, linker or target-native execution occurred during this static audit.
These checks establish binary symbol/header availability only when run against actual outputs; they do not validate runtime pairing, fd behavior or allocator behavior.

symbol_reader.reason: Apple Xcode nm rejects compiler_builtins bitcode from the pinned Rust LLVM version; inspect with that exact Rust host toolchain component instead.
